Orbit direction taken from the three generated frames, not from the words: from the front right three quarter view toward HIS RIGHT flank, the number edge on by 45, as in 1-6-BULLET-45-v1. On falling versus posing: the torso stays behind the hips and the feet ahead of them at every angle and the arms hang, so it reads as losing through the whole turn, except the four near frontal frames at 135 to 165 and 315 to 345 where the lean is toward the camera and he looks like he is standing, which is geometry and not the pose.
